      "source": "Lay a pressure triggered trap that collapses the ground under the target, dealing %0.2f physical damage while burying them (removing from combat) for 5 turns.\nVictims may resist being buried, in which case they are pinned (ignores 50%% pin immunity) instead.",

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/cunning/traps.lua",
      "source": "Lay a trap that creates a radius 5 gravitic anomaly when triggered by foes approaching within range 1.  Each turn, the anomaly deals %0.2f temporal damage (based on your Magic) to foes while pulling them towards its center (chance increases with your combat accuracy or spell power, whichever is higher).\n\t\tEach anomaly lasts %d turns (up to the amount of time since the last anomaly dissipated, based on your Trap Mastery skill).\n\t\tThe trap may trigger more than once, but requires at least 2 turns to recharge between activations.\nThis design does not require advanced preparation to use.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "放置一个引力陷阱。当敌人接近至 1 格内时，陷阱会触发并制造一个半径 5 格的重力异常。每回合，异常会对敌人造成 %0.2f 点时空伤害（基于你的魔力），同时将其拉向中心；拉动成功率随你的命中或法术强度（取较高者）提高。\n\t\t每个异常最多持续 %d 回合；实际持续时间不超过上一个异常消散至今经过的回合数，并受你的陷阱专精技能影响。\n\t\t该陷阱可触发多次，但每次触发后至少需要 2 回合重新充能。\n使用这个设计无需进行高级准备。"
    }
